in_marathi.name: Raihansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, Moon, and Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raihansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raihansh is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Rai (Sun) and Hansh (Moon and Wealth). The name symbolizes the power of the Sun and the wealth of the Moon, representing a balanced and prosperous life.
